cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved our first dinner since the breakup. That groan at my waiter joke is a promising start.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your memory passes. We still have our little traditions, even the ones you complain about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Silence granted. You still trust me enough to ask for what you need. I'll authorize dessert too; we can enjoy a longer silence together.
